responsibility: This header declares the text-art subsystem’s public helper for box-drawing lookup, get_box_drawing_char(directions). It is the narrow interface that exposes conversion from abstract cardinal-connection state in text_art::directions to a Unicode line-art code point, separating callers such as theme rendering from the generated lookup-table implementation.
same_name_distinction: Declares the box-drawing lookup interface used by other text-art code; unlike gcc/text-art/box-drawing.cc, it does not define the generated lookup table or the function body.
